nodes.name: Heartbeat (Every 15 Min)
nodes.notes: The heartbeat. Runs every 15 minutes 24/7. Dispatches all scheduled jobs.

nodes.name: Time Router
nodes.notes: Determines what jobs to run based on current IST time.

nodes.name: Get Pending Tasks
nodes.notes: Reads pending tasks from the Task Queue sheet. Replace YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID with your actual sheet ID.

nodes.name: Get Open Errors
nodes.notes: Checks for unresolved errors. Any open errors trigger an alert.

nodes.name: Get Pending Approvals
nodes.notes: Checks approval queue. Items waiting > 2 hours trigger a reminder.

nodes.name: Build Morning Digest
nodes.notes: Assembles the morning WhatsApp digest from all data sources.

nodes.name: System Health Check
nodes.notes: Evaluates system health. Flags critical errors for immediate alerting.

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp to Ankur
nodes.notes: Sends digest/report to Ankur's WhatsApp. Replace YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER_WITH_COUNTRY_CODE with +91XXXXXXXXXX

nodes.name: Log Execution
nodes.notes: Logs every scheduler run to the Error Log for audit trail.
